headline: ENHYPEN returns with spinoff single 'THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD'
sub: The new single closes out the group's 'THE SIN' series
caption:
ENHYPEN is back today with their new single 'THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD'.

Released on Nov 20, the spinoff single wraps up the group's 'THE SIN' series. Speaking to Korean media ahead of the release, the members said they want to be "a team that does well with any concept."

📌 Source: Yonhap News (via Korean media)
